risk_summary: The disclosure identifies meaningful exposure to demand volatility, customer concentration, supply-chain disruptions, outsourced manufacturing dependencies, tariffs, pandemic effects, and intellectual-property litigation. It provides several quantified liquidity and capital-commitment figures and expresses confidence that available liquidity and operating cash flow will fund planned needs, although portions rely on broad forward-looking qualifiers.
